drafts.title.description: Heading and document title of the page that lists the user's drafts saved on the server and their scheduled posts; also the link to it under the new-post form.

drafts.save.description: Button beside the submit button of the new-post form: saves what is written as a draft on the server, which opens on any device, and empties the form.

drafts.saved.description: Toast after the new-post form saved a draft on the server; the form is empty again.

drafts.save.blocked.empty.defaultMessage: Es gibt noch nichts zu speichern.
drafts.save.blocked.empty.description: Beside the save-draft button of the new-post form, after it was pressed with no text, content warning, attachment, or poll: why nothing was saved.

drafts.save.blocked.uploading.defaultMessage: Warte, bis die Anhänge hochgeladen sind, und speichere dann.
drafts.save.blocked.uploading.description: Beside the save-draft button of the new-post form, after it was pressed while a file is still uploading: why nothing was saved.

drafts.save.blocked.upload_failed.defaultMessage: Entferne den Anhang, dessen Upload fehlgeschlagen ist, und speichere dann.
drafts.save.blocked.upload_failed.description: Beside the save-draft button of the new-post form, after it was pressed while an attachment failed to upload: why nothing was saved.

drafts.save.conflict.defaultMessage: Dieser Entwurf wurde auf einem anderen Gerät geändert. Speichere erneut, um diesen als neuen Entwurf zu behalten.
drafts.save.conflict.description: Beside the save-draft button of the new-post form: the draft being edited was saved on another device since it was opened, so it was not overwritten. Saving again makes a new draft.

drafts.save.failed.defaultMessage: Der Entwurf konnte nicht gespeichert werden: {reason}
drafts.save.failed.description: Beside the save-draft button of the new-post form when saving failed. {reason} is the server's or the network's localized reason.

drafts.editing.description: Line above the tools of the new-post form while it holds a draft opened from the drafts page: saving replaces that draft, and posting deletes it.

drafts.editing.scheduled.description: Line above the tools of the new-post form while it holds a scheduled draft. {date} is the formatted date and time in the user's time zone.

drafts.schedule.label.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the tool button of the new-post form that opens the date and time to publish the post at; also the title of that popover.

drafts.schedule.label.scheduled.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the schedule button of the new-post form while the draft is scheduled. {date} is the formatted date and time it is scheduled for.

drafts.schedule.date.description: Label of the date field of the schedule popover.

drafts.schedule.time.description: Label of the time field of the schedule popover.

drafts.schedule.time_zone.defaultMessage: Datum und Uhrzeit gelten in deiner Zeitzone, {zone}.
drafts.schedule.time_zone.description: Description of the schedule popover's fields. {zone} is the name of the user's time zone (for example 'Japan Standard Time'), which the settings choose.

drafts.schedule.submit.description: Button of the schedule popover: saves the draft and schedules it for the chosen date and time.

drafts.schedule.invalid.defaultMessage: Gib ein Datum und eine Uhrzeit ein.
drafts.schedule.invalid.description: Error under the fields of the schedule popover when the date or the time is missing or not a valid one.

drafts.schedule.too_soon.defaultMessage: Wähle eine Zeit, die mindestens {minutes, plural, one {# Minute} other {# Minuten}} in der Zukunft liegt.
drafts.schedule.too_soon.description: Error under the fields of the schedule popover: the time is in the past or sooner than the server allows. {minutes} is the server's least lead time.

drafts.schedule.too_far.defaultMessage: Wähle eine Zeit innerhalb der nächsten {days, plural, one {# Tag} other {# Tage}}.
drafts.schedule.too_far.description: Error under the fields of the schedule popover: the time is further ahead than the server allows. {days} is the server's most lead time.

drafts.schedule.scheduled.description: Toast and announcement after a post was scheduled. {date} is the formatted date and time in the user's time zone.

drafts.schedule.failed.defaultMessage: Der Beitrag konnte nicht geplant werden: {reason}
drafts.schedule.failed.description: Error in the schedule popover when the server refused or the network failed. {reason} is the localized reason.

drafts.scheduled.heading.description: Heading of the section of the drafts page that lists the drafts scheduled to be published; also the name of its list.

drafts.scheduled.empty.description: Empty state of the scheduled posts of the drafts page.

drafts.scheduled.empty.description.defaultMessage: Plane einen Beitrag im Formular für neue Beiträge, um ihn zu einer von dir gewählten Zeit zu veröffentlichen.
drafts.scheduled.empty.description.description: Description of the empty state of the scheduled posts of the drafts page.

drafts.unscheduled.heading.description: Heading of the section of the drafts page that lists the drafts without a schedule; also the name of its list.

drafts.unscheduled.empty.description: Empty state of the drafts of the drafts page.

drafts.unscheduled.empty.description.defaultMessage: Wähle „Entwurf speichern“ im Formular für neue Beiträge, um einen Beitrag zu behalten und später auf einem beliebigen Gerät fertigzustellen.
drafts.unscheduled.empty.description.description: Description of the empty state of the drafts of the drafts page. The quoted words are the label of the save-draft button.

drafts.row.no_text.description: In a row of the drafts page, in place of the text of a draft that has no text and no content warning.

drafts.row.publish_at.description: In a row of the scheduled posts: when it is published. {date} is the formatted date and time in the user's time zone.

drafts.row.updated_at.description: In a row of the drafts: when the draft was last saved. {date} is the formatted date and time in the user's time zone.

drafts.row.media.description: In a row of the drafts page: how many files the draft attaches.

drafts.row.poll.description: In a row of the drafts page: the draft has a poll.

drafts.row.reply.description: In a row of the drafts page: the draft replies to a post.

drafts.row.quote.description: In a row of the drafts page: the draft quotes a post.

drafts.row.article.description: In a row of the drafts page: the draft is of an article, whose title the row shows; editing it opens the article editor.

drafts.action.description: Accessible name of a button of a row of the drafts page. {action} is the button's visible text (for example 'Edit'), {excerpt} the start of the draft's text.

drafts.edit.description: Button of a row of the drafts page: opens the draft in the new-post form.

drafts.reschedule.description: Button of a row of the scheduled posts: opens the popover that moves the schedule to another date and time.

drafts.unschedule.description: Button of a row of the scheduled posts: cancels the schedule; the draft stays, among the drafts.

drafts.unscheduled.description: Announcement after a schedule was cancelled; the draft moved to the drafts.

drafts.delete.description: Button of a row of the drafts page, and the confirm button of its dialog: deletes the draft and its schedule.

drafts.delete.title.description: Title of the dialog that confirms deleting a draft.

drafts.delete.body.defaultMessage: Der Entwurf wird auf jedem Gerät gelöscht, und seine Planung mit ihm. Das lässt sich nicht rückgängig machen.
drafts.delete.body.description: Body of the dialog that confirms deleting a draft.

drafts.deleted.description: Announcement after a draft was deleted.

drafts.cancel.description: The way out of the dialogs of the drafts page (delete, replace).

drafts.replace.title.description: Title of the dialog shown when a draft is opened while the new-post form holds something else.

drafts.replace.body.defaultMessage: Das Formular für neue Beiträge enthält einen Beitrag, an dem du schreibst. Das Öffnen dieses Entwurfs ersetzt ihn.
drafts.replace.body.description: Body of the dialog shown when a draft is opened while the new-post form holds something else.

drafts.replace.confirm.description: Confirm button of the dialog that replaces what the new-post form holds with the opened draft.

drafts.gone.defaultMessage: Dieser Entwurf existiert nicht mehr. Er wurde möglicherweise auf einem anderen Gerät veröffentlicht oder gelöscht.
drafts.gone.description: Announcement when a draft to open, schedule, or delete is gone from the server.

drafts.notification_link.description: Link in the notification that a scheduled post could not be published, to the drafts page where the draft is kept.

drafts.publish.conflict.defaultMessage: Dieser Entwurf wurde auf einem anderen Gerät geändert, daher wurde nichts veröffentlicht. Veröffentliche erneut, um diese Version als neuen Beitrag zu veröffentlichen.
drafts.publish.conflict.description: Under the new-post form when posting a draft opened from the drafts page failed because the draft was saved on another device since it was opened: nothing was posted or overwritten. Posting again posts this version as a new post.
